verdict.rationale: Bland documents an official Web Agent SDK for embedding a voice agent into React, Vanilla JS, or Node apps, with server-side authentication handling. It also has an /sdks section that includes a CLI. However, the evidence shows only this narrow embedding SDK, not general-purpose API client SDKs, and no OpenAPI spec was found to generate clients. Missing for 10: general-purpose API client SDKs (e.g. Python/Node for calls, pathways, agents), multi-language coverage, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Embed a Bland voice agent into any web application (React, Vanilla JS, or Node). The SDK handles secure authentication between your server and Bland, so your API key is never exposed to the browser.
Manage your entire Bland account from the terminal: make calls, build and test pathways, configure phone numbers, and more.
